story.body: You read the last days and put one question in the margin. You did not open yesterday's pages to answer it.

title: Wrote one question beside the chronicle

participation.context: Wrote the two notes, wrote no line, and shut the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the two sentences and nothing else. You shut Verona. You left the king alone.

title: Wrote two notes at Verona and shut the book

participation.context: Said the three things, and sat still.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the sentence at the window. You did not follow it with work.

title: Named a king, two houses, and Easter, and stopped
